indexRace: This dispatch's commit 5efb0f1 also carries the concurrent NOVA-PO-CONFIRM-1 dispatch's two files. It ran git add on only its own paths, but the shared non-worktree checkout's index already held the other dispatch's staged files, and git commit -F committed the whole index. The dispatch detected and disclosed this itself and declined to un-commit it while the other session was live, which was the right call. Consequence for provenance: 5efb0f1's Dispatch: NOVA-RESTART-RUNNER-1 trailer does NOT cover its whole diff.
